record.name: Lionheart
record.rules_text:
<Alert> (This character can challenge as if they had Evasive.)

\Civic Duty\ 6 {I} — Remove all damage from chosen character or location.
record.subtitle: Cleaning Up the City

record.author: Mario Oscar Gabriele
record.name: Priscilla
record.rules_text:
\Not-So-Secret Crush\ This character enters play exerted.

\Filing System\ Whenever this character quests, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck. Put one into your hand and the other into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
record.subtitle: Efficient Clerk

record.author: Amanda Duarte
record.flavor_text: Life in Hyperia City had never been better.
record.name: Daisy Duck
record.rules_text: \Save for the Future\ When you play this character, you may put a card from your hand into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
record.subtitle: Savvy Investor

record.author: Ada Devecchi
record.name: Thomas O'Malley
record.rules_text: \Lucky Break\ Whenever this character quests, each player reveals the top card of their deck. Put the card with the highest cost revealed this way, or each card tied for highest cost, into its player's hand. Put the rest on the bottom of their players' decks.
record.subtitle: Savvy Vagabond

record.author: Valentina Graziuso
record.name: Duchess
record.rules_text:
\Upper Crust\ While you have a character in play with the highest cost, or tied for highest cost, this character gets +1 {L}.

\Proper Etiquette\ Whenever this character quests, look at the top card of your deck. Put that card on either the top or the bottom of your deck.
record.subtitle: Cosmopolitan Cat

record.author: Jared Mathews / Amber Kommavongsa
record.name: Judy Hopps
record.rules_text:
<Support> (Whenever this character quests, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)

\Lend a Paw\ When you play this character, if you played another character this turn, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted.
record.subtitle: Day Camp Instructor

record.author: Otto Paredes
record.name: Nick Wilde
record.rules_text: \I've Got This\ While you have another Detective character in play, this character gains <Support>. (Whenever they quest, you may add their {S} to another chosen character's {S} this turn.)
record.subtitle: Providing Backup

record.author: Aristeidis Zentelis
record.name: Aurora
record.rules_text:
\Melodic Refrain\ When you play this character, return a song card you played this turn with cost 3 or less from your discard to your hand.

\Joyous Reception\ At the end of your turn, if you played a song this turn, gain 1 lore.
record.subtitle: Delightful Musician

record.author: Randy Bishop
record.name: Baymax
record.rules_text:
<Shift> Remove 2 ink drops

\Supercharge\ If you would get an ink drop, you may put the top card of your deck into your inkwell facedown and exerted instead.
record.subtitle: Amped Up

record.author: Jochem Van Gool
record.name: Mickey Mouse
record.rules_text:
<Adventurous>

\Hot Dog!\ At the end of your turn, if this character is exerted, each player gets 1 ink drop.
record.subtitle: Best in Town
